It's America's first Dark Pumpernickel Rye Whiskey. This signature spirit is distilled from dark pumpernickel rye, non-GMO open-pollinated yellow corn, soft red winter wheat, and 2-row barley to create a unique four grain rye. SPECIFICATIONS FORMAT 750 mL MINIMUM MATURATION TIME 4 years ABV 48% (96 proof) MASH BILL Dark Pumpernickel Rye Ohio Soft Red Winter Wheat Non-GMO, Open Pollinated Yellow Corn 2-row Barley CASK TYPES Toasted and Charred American White Oak
